answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks through hydrodynamic attestation. Each agent continuously samples solar irradiance across the saffron spectrum in an open lagoon, cross-referencing depth attenuation with the local tide. Creating forged identities requires an attacker to deploy scarce submersible spectrometers and dedicated marine hardware per node. However, sediment drift and sudden algal blooms introduce environmental noise that can falsely invalidate honest agents.
